description: This file implements functions for obtaining and mixing seed material from various operating system sources, including platform-specific entropy sources, for the Abseil C++ library's random internal module.

methods.name: ReadSeedMaterialFromOSEntropyImpl
methods.description: Reads OS entropy into a span of uint32_t values, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: ReadSeedMaterialFromOSEntropy
methods.description: Public function to read OS entropy, calls platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: MixIntoSeedMaterial
methods.description: Mixes a sequence of uint32_t values into seed material for randomness seeding.

methods.name: GetSaltMaterial
methods.description: Retrieves a process-wide salt value for seeding, reading from OS entropy once.
